game_title: Validation Fortress – Dust Devil Plain Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain, a plain of dust devils: the camel trader must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so sand wyrms can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain: a plain of dust devils
core_gameplay_loop: In Dust Devil Plain, repeat each round: Write input checks that reject bad data so sand wyrms can't sneak through. Each round, sand wyrms strike the water well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fortress value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the water well from sand wyrms in Dust Devil Plain: keep the fortress meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: fortress drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Validation Fortress
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Dust Devil Plain'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fortress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dust Devil Plain.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while fortress > 0.
